Agent Name: Assistant
Step Number: 27
Reason for Mistake: The Assistant miscalculated the daily ticket total by counting only one child as paying and implicitly treating the 2-year-old as free, even though only infants under 1 are free. This undercounted the per-visit cost (should have included 2 adults + 2 children), leading to an incorrect savings comparison.
